hook.name: PmavHookQuoted
hook.description: A bonding-curve launchpad hook for meme coins that enforces a block+1 anti-snipe delay, a permanent 2% wallet cap, and a quote-denominated protocol fee, then automatically graduates the pool to a standard 1% Uniswap v4 LP pool when the curve fills. Supports an optional hookData refund beneficiary that is safely ignored when absent.
